WITH january_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('completed', 'paid')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
),
exchange_rates(currency, usd_per_unit) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.09),
        ('JPY', 0.0067)
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN j.currency = 'EUR' THEN j.amount_minor / 100.0 * r.usd_per_unit
            WHEN j.currency = 'JPY' THEN j.amount_minor * r.usd_per_unit
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM january_orders j
JOIN exchange_rates r
    ON r.currency = j.currency;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.04),
        ('JPY', 0.0066)
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * fx.rate_to_usd) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor * 1.08
            WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * 0.0067
        END
    ) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status IN ('completed', 'paid')
  AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders o

      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
)
SELECT

            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor * 1.10 / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders;

SELECT

FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')

  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL

  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01';

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor * 1.08

        END
    ) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c

WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) AS refunded_minor
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_minor
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN (amount_minor - refunded_minor) * 1.04
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN (amount_minor - refunded_minor) * 0.0064
        END
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.04),
        ('JPY', 0.0066)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        r.rate_to_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
       AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    JOIN fx_rates r
        ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN eligible_orders o
        ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            (o.amount_minor - COALESCE(rt.refunded_minor, 0))
            / CASE WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN 1.0 ELSE 100.0 END
            * o.rate_to_usd
        ),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders o
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt
    ON rt.order_id = o.order_id;

WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        CASE
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * 0.0067
        END AS revenue_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
),
refunds_usd AS (
    SELECT
        mo.order_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN mo.currency = 'EUR' THEN r.amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
                WHEN mo.currency = 'JPY' THEN r.amount_minor * 0.0067
            END
        ) AS refunded_usd
    FROM monthly_orders mo
    JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = mo.order_id
    GROUP BY mo.order_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(mo.revenue_usd), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(ru.refunded_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM monthly_orders mo
LEFT JOIN refunds_usd ru ON ru.order_id = mo.order_id;

WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * 0.0067
        END AS gross_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
),
refunds_usd AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(
            CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN r.amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN r.amount_minor * 0.0067
            END
        ) AS refunded_usd
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(mo.gross_usd - COALESCE(ru.refunded_usd, 0)),

) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM monthly_orders mo
LEFT JOIN refunds_usd ru ON ru.order_id = mo.order_id;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'apparel'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'NA'
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
converted AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * 0.0067
        END AS order_value_usd
    FROM order_totals
)
SELECT AVG(order_value_usd) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM converted;

      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE

        CASE
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor * 1.08
            WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor * 0.0067
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')

  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.currency
)

    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue;

WITH january_customers AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) AS DOUBLE)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share
FROM january_customers;
